suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update 'API Clients' section: Remove 'All 10 are currently static classes. Each ~250-315 lines with ~60-70% boilerplate (DTOs, serialization, HTTP). All implement IDisposable. Constructor signatures differ (2-4 params).' Replace with: 'All 10 API clients extend LlmClientBase (abstract, implements ILlmClient). Each overrides BuildRequestBody()/ExtractText() for provider-specific logic. LlmClientFactory creates clients by LlmApiType enum. Clients are non-static, instantiated via factory, and share HTTP logic through the base class.'

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The test-worker skill should document the Unity reference-assembly constraint for RimWorld mods: runtime instantiation of mod types fails because Krafs.RimWorld.Ref provides compile-time-only assemblies. Recommend adding a note that source-level characterization tests (regex on .cs files) are the primary approach for testing mod types that depend on Unity/Verse assemblies.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both setup-test-project (session 831d9425) and api-layer-tests (session 30a2aa8b) workers discovered this constraint through trial and error, spending multiple iterations before pivoting to source-level tests. Both reported skill deviations on this point.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The worker-base/init.sh startup procedure is not Windows-compatible. Workers consistently cannot execute .factory/init.sh in PowerShell and fall back to direct dotnet restore. Consider making init.sh cross-platform or adding a Windows-specific init script.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All 3 features in this milestone reported init.sh execution failure as a skill deviation. Same pattern observed in structural-cleanup milestone. This is a systemic cross-session issue.
